facts.text: 20,000 paying subscribers were scored this week.
About 1,835 subscribers are expected to cancel in the next 30 days (9% of the base).
Total monthly revenue at risk is PKR 547,507.
The high-risk group is the top 2,000 subscribers (top 10%), with PKR 187,604 of revenue at risk.
'Watching much less than last week' is a top reason for 61% of the high-risk group.
'Failed renewals' is a top reason for 54% of the high-risk group.
'On a Daily pack' is a top reason for 41% of the high-risk group.
'Sports series ended' is a top reason for 39% of the high-risk group.
'Inactive 5+ days' is a top reason for 39% of the high-risk group.
The riskiest plan is Daily: average churn risk 12%, PKR 206,377 at risk.
The riskiest payment channel is Operator 4: average churn risk 10%, PKR 62,465 at risk.
The riskiest genre is Sports: average churn risk 10%, PKR 287,883 at risk.
If the team contacts the top 10% by score, about 28% of them are real leavers, 3.01 times better than contacting people at random.
